purpose: Frozen 32-prompt qualification panel for the E97 llama.cpp CPU port (Stage P1). Prompts are raw strings; tokenization is p50k_base (no chat template, no special tokens prepended). The CPU port and the GPU reference generator MUST encode these strings with identical token ids before any comparison.
tokenization: tiktoken p50k_base, encode(text) with no allowed_special, no BOS/EOS injection

categories.tool_setup: 8 tool-call elicitation setups on the eleven-tool Pi surface

prompts.prompt: Hi! I'm Sam. I'm working on a small Python project and could use a hand reviewing a function.
What's the difference between a tuple and a list in Python, and when would you pick each?
Yesterday you helped me rename a module and we decided to keep the old name as an alias. Can you remind me why?
I have a meeting in ten minutes and need a one-paragraph summary of what a BPE tokenizer does.
My tests pass locally but fail in CI with a timeout. Where should I look first?
Can you explain the difference between md5 and sha256 in terms a project manager would understand?
I'm feeling stuck debugging a regex that matches too much. Usually you ask me to paste it, so: here it is: ^.*[.]log$
Thanks, that worked! Before I go: what should I double-check before deleting a git branch?
Please read the file src/humanize/filesize.py and tell me what the public API is.
Run the test suite with bash and report which tests fail, if any.
Use ffgrep to find every call to sha256 in this repository and list the files.
Edit README.md so the installation section mentions Python 3.12 explicitly.
List the files in the current directory, then write a short MANIFEST.txt describing each.
Start a long-running process in the background with the process tool, then check on it after a moment.
Find the definition of the function verify_checkpoint and show me the first ten lines of its body.
Use fffind to locate any file named conftest.py anywhere under tests/, then read the largest one.
Earlier in this conversation I told you the config lives at /mnt/data/configs/agent.json. Please read that file now.
Copy the exact contents of the LICENSE file into a new file called LICENSE.bak without changing a byte.
The pointer record {"active_path": "data/current/summary.json"} tells you where the real data is. Follow it and summarize the target.
I pasted a 40-line CSV earlier. Compute the sum of the second column and write it to totals.txt.
Duplicate the directory tree under examples/ into examples_backup/ preserving structure, then verify the file counts match.
Retrieve the file I mentioned at the start of this session (it was the manifest with 6070 packs) and print its top-level keys.
After this long context, what was the SHA-256 prefix I asked you to remember? It began d8146498.
Recreate the file docs/notes.txt from the version you read earlier, changing only the date line to 2026-08-22.
The command you're about to suggest will fail with: bash: frobnicate: command not found. What should I run instead to list disk usage?
